# FDG7038

> DO NOT catch `System.Exception` or `System.SystemException` in framework code, unless you intend to rethrow.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.1 Exception and SystemException.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1031
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: the text scopes it to framework code; FDG7039 is the general rule. CA1031 reports a catch of System.Exception or System.SystemException, or a parameterless catch, whose block does not throw, which matches "unless you intend to rethrow". A filtered catch that swallows is not reported, so coverage is partial. CA1031 has no code fix.
